cards.q: What is a projectile?
cards.a: An object upon which the only force acting is the force of gravity.
cards.qAf: Wat is 'n projektiel?
cards.aAf: 'n Voorwerp waarop die enigste krag wat inwerk die gravitasiekrag is.

cards.q: What is free fall?
cards.a: Motion during which the only force acting on an object is the gravitational force (air resistance is ignored).
cards.qAf: Wat is vrye val?
cards.aAf: Beweging waartydens die enigste krag op 'n voorwerp die gravitasiekrag is (lugweerstand word geïgnoreer).

cards.q: What is the acceleration of a projectile on the way up, at the top and on the way down?
cards.a: 9.8 m·s⁻² downward at every point, including the highest point.
cards.qAf: Wat is die versnelling van 'n projektiel op pad op, by die hoogste punt en op pad af?
cards.aAf: 9,8 m·s⁻² afwaarts by elke punt, ook by die hoogste punt.

cards.q: What is the velocity of an object at its maximum height?
cards.a: vf = 0 m·s⁻¹. It is momentarily at rest, but the acceleration is still 9.8 m·s⁻² downward.
cards.qAf: Wat is die snelheid van 'n voorwerp by sy maksimum hoogte?
cards.aAf: vf = 0 m·s⁻¹. Dit is oombliklik in rus, maar die versnelling is steeds 9,8 m·s⁻² afwaarts.

cards.q: A ball is thrown up and returns to the same level. Compare its speed and time on the way up and down.
cards.a: Same speed when it returns (opposite direction), and time up = time down. This symmetry only holds when air resistance is ignored.
cards.qAf: 'n Bal word opgegooi en keer terug na dieselfde vlak. Vergelyk die spoed en tyd op pad op en af.
cards.aAf: Dieselfde spoed wanneer dit terugkeer (teenoorgestelde rigting), en tyd op = tyd af. Hierdie simmetrie geld net as lugweerstand geïgnoreer word.

cards.q: Write down the four equations of motion.
cards.a:
vf = vi + aΔt
Δy = viΔt + ½aΔt²
vf² = vi² + 2aΔy
Δy = ((vi + vf) / 2)Δt
cards.qAf: Skryf die vier bewegingsvergelykings neer.
cards.aAf:
vf = vi + aΔt
Δy = viΔt + ½aΔt²
vf² = vi² + 2aΔy
Δy = ((vi + vf) / 2)Δt

cards.q: How do you calculate the time to reach maximum height?
cards.a: Use vf = vi + aΔt with vf = 0, so Δt = vi / g (with g = 9.8 m·s⁻²).
cards.qAf: Hoe bereken jy die tyd om die maksimum hoogte te bereik?
cards.aAf: Gebruik vf = vi + aΔt met vf = 0, dus Δt = vi / g (met g = 9,8 m·s⁻²).

cards.q: Describe the velocity–time graph of a projectile.
cards.a: A straight line with a constant gradient equal to the acceleration (−9.8 m·s⁻² if upward is positive). It crosses the time axis at maximum height.
cards.qAf: Beskryf die snelheid-tyd-grafiek van 'n projektiel.
cards.aAf: 'n Reguit lyn met 'n konstante gradiënt gelyk aan die versnelling (−9,8 m·s⁻² as opwaarts positief is). Dit sny die tyd-as by die maksimum hoogte.

cards.q: What does the area under a velocity–time graph represent?
cards.a: The displacement (Δy).
cards.qAf: Wat stel die oppervlakte onder 'n snelheid-tyd-grafiek voor?
cards.aAf: Die verplasing (Δy).

cards.q: Describe the position–time graph of an object thrown upward.
cards.a: A parabola. The gradient at any point is the velocity, and the turning point is the maximum height (gradient = 0).
cards.qAf: Beskryf die posisie-tyd-grafiek van 'n voorwerp wat opwaarts gegooi word.
cards.aAf: 'n Parabool. Die gradiënt by enige punt is die snelheid, en die draaipunt is die maksimum hoogte (gradiënt = 0).

cards.q: What does a bounce look like on a velocity–time graph?
cards.a: The velocity changes direction almost instantly (a vertical jump across the time axis). The lines before and after still have the same gradient, −9.8 m·s⁻².
cards.qAf: Hoe lyk 'n bons op 'n snelheid-tyd-grafiek?
cards.aAf: Die snelheid verander byna oombliklik van rigting ('n vertikale sprong oor die tyd-as). Die lyne voor en ná het steeds dieselfde gradiënt, −9,8 m·s⁻².

cards.q: Two objects are launched at different times. How do you find when they meet?
cards.a: Write Δy for each object using its own flight time (t and t + t₀), then set their positions equal and solve for t.
cards.qAf: Twee voorwerpe word op verskillende tye gelanseer. Hoe bepaal jy wanneer hulle ontmoet?
cards.aAf: Skryf Δy vir elke voorwerp met sy eie vlugtyd (t en t + t₀), stel dan hul posisies gelyk en los op vir t.

cards.q: Define the Doppler effect.
cards.a: The change in frequency (or pitch) of the sound detected by a listener because the sound source and the listener have different velocities relative to the medium of sound propagation.
cards.qAf: Definieer die Doppler-effek.
cards.aAf: Die verandering in frekwensie (of toonhoogte) van die klank wat deur 'n luisteraar waargeneem word omdat die klankbron en die luisteraar verskillende snelhede relatief tot die medium van klankvoortplanting het.

cards.q: A sound source moves towards a listener. What happens to the wavelength and frequency the listener detects?
cards.a: The wavefronts are compressed: shorter wavelength, higher frequency (higher pitch).
cards.qAf: 'n Klankbron beweeg na 'n luisteraar toe. Wat gebeur met die golflengte en frekwensie wat die luisteraar waarneem?
cards.aAf: Die golffronte word saamgepers: korter golflengte, hoër frekwensie (hoër toonhoogte).

cards.q: A sound source moves away from a listener. What does the listener detect?
cards.a: The wavefronts are stretched: longer wavelength, lower frequency (lower pitch).
cards.qAf: 'n Klankbron beweeg weg van 'n luisteraar. Wat neem die luisteraar waar?
cards.aAf: Die golffronte word uitgerek: langer golflengte, laer frekwensie (laer toonhoogte).

cards.q: Write down the Doppler equation.
cards.a:
fL = ((v ± vL) / (v ± vS)) × fS
fL = frequency heard, fS = source frequency, v = speed of sound, vL = listener speed, vS = source speed.
cards.qAf: Skryf die Doppler-vergelyking neer.
cards.aAf:
fL = ((v ± vL) / (v ± vS)) × fS
fL = frekwensie gehoor, fS = bronfrekwensie, v = spoed van klank, vL = spoed van luisteraar, vS = spoed van bron.

cards.q: Which signs do you use in the Doppler equation?
cards.a:
Listener moving towards the source: +vL; away: −vL.
Source moving towards the listener: −vS; away: +vS.
(Moving towards always makes fL bigger.)
cards.qAf: Watter tekens gebruik jy in die Doppler-vergelyking?
cards.aAf:
Luisteraar beweeg na die bron toe: +vL; weg: −vL.
Bron beweeg na die luisteraar toe: −vS; weg: +vS.
(Na mekaar toe beweeg maak fL altyd groter.)

cards.q: What value is used for the speed of sound in air?
cards.qAf: Watter waarde word vir die spoed van klank in lug gebruik?

cards.q: Why does an ambulance siren sound higher as it approaches and lower after it passes?
cards.a: Approaching: more wavefronts reach you per second, so the frequency heard is higher. Receding: fewer per second, so it is lower. The siren's own frequency does not change.
cards.qAf: Waarom klink 'n ambulans se sirene hoër soos dit nader en laer nadat dit verby is?
cards.aAf: Nader: meer golffronte bereik jou per sekonde, dus is die frekwensie wat jy hoor hoër. Weg: minder per sekonde, dus laer. Die sirene se eie frekwensie verander nie.

cards.q: Give a medical use of the Doppler effect.
cards.a: Doppler ultrasound (flow meter): ultrasound reflected off moving blood cells changes frequency, which gives the speed of blood flow. It is also used to monitor a foetal heartbeat.
cards.qAf: Gee 'n mediese gebruik van die Doppler-effek.
cards.aAf: Doppler-ultraklank (vloeimeter): ultraklank wat van bewegende bloedselle weerkaats, verander van frekwensie, wat die spoed van bloedvloei gee. Dit word ook gebruik om 'n fetus se hartklop te monitor.

cards.q: What is a red shift?
cards.a: Light from a star or galaxy moving away from us is shifted to longer wavelengths (lower frequencies), towards the red end of the spectrum.
cards.qAf: Wat is 'n rooiverskuiwing?
cards.aAf: Lig van 'n ster of sterrestelsel wat van ons af wegbeweeg, word na langer golflengtes (laer frekwensies) verskuif, na die rooi kant van die spektrum.

cards.q: What does the red shift of distant galaxies tell us about the universe?
cards.a: The galaxies are moving away from us, which is evidence that the universe is expanding.
cards.qAf: Wat sê die rooiverskuiwing van verafgeleë sterrestelsels vir ons oor die heelal?
cards.aAf: Die sterrestelsels beweeg van ons af weg, wat bewys is dat die heelal uitdy.

cards.q: What is a blue shift?
cards.a: Light from a source moving towards us is shifted to shorter wavelengths (higher frequencies), towards the blue end of the spectrum.
cards.qAf: Wat is 'n blouverskuiwing?
cards.aAf: Lig van 'n bron wat na ons toe beweeg, word na korter golflengtes (hoër frekwensies) verskuif, na die blou kant van die spektrum.

cards.q: What is the emf (ε) of a battery?
cards.a: The maximum energy provided by a battery per coulomb of charge passing through it. It equals the potential difference across the terminals when no current flows.
cards.qAf: Wat is die EMK (ε) van 'n battery?
cards.aAf: Die maksimum energie wat 'n battery per coulomb lading wat daardeur beweeg, verskaf. Dit is gelyk aan die potensiaalverskil oor die terminale wanneer geen stroom vloei nie.

cards.q: What is internal resistance?
cards.a: The resistance inside a battery (of its chemicals) that causes the potential difference across the terminals to drop when a current flows.
cards.qAf: Wat is interne weerstand?
cards.aAf: Die weerstand binne-in 'n battery (van sy chemikalieë) wat veroorsaak dat die potensiaalverskil oor die terminale daal wanneer 'n stroom vloei.

cards.q: How are emf, terminal potential difference and internal resistance related?
cards.a:
ε = Vterminal + Ir, so Vterminal = ε − Ir.
Also ε = I(R + r).
cards.qAf: Hoe hou EMK, terminale potensiaalverskil en interne weerstand verband?
cards.aAf:
ε = Vterminaal + Ir, dus Vterminaal = ε − Ir.
Ook ε = I(R + r).

cards.q: What are the 'lost volts'?
cards.a: The potential difference across the internal resistance: Vlost = Ir. It is energy per coulomb converted to heat inside the battery.
cards.qAf: Wat is die 'verlore spanning'?
cards.aAf: Die potensiaalverskil oor die interne weerstand: Vverlore = Ir. Dit is energie per coulomb wat binne-in die battery na hitte omgeskakel word.

cards.q: More resistors are added in parallel to the external circuit. What happens to the current and the terminal potential difference?
cards.a: Total external resistance decreases, so the current increases. Ir increases, so the terminal potential difference decreases.
cards.qAf: Meer resistors word in parallel by die eksterne stroombaan gevoeg. Wat gebeur met die stroom en die terminale potensiaalverskil?
cards.aAf: Die totale eksterne weerstand neem af, dus neem die stroom toe. Ir neem toe, dus neem die terminale potensiaalverskil af.

cards.q: State Ohm's law.
cards.a: The potential difference across a conductor is directly proportional to the current in the conductor at constant temperature.
cards.qAf: Stel die wet van Ohm.
cards.aAf: Die potensiaalverskil oor 'n geleier is direk eweredig aan die stroom in die geleier by konstante temperatuur.

cards.q: How do you calculate the total resistance of resistors in series and in parallel?
cards.a:
Series: Rs = R1 + R2 + …
Parallel: 1/Rp = 1/R1 + 1/R2 + …
cards.qAf: Hoe bereken jy die totale weerstand van resistors in serie en in parallel?
cards.aAf:
Serie: Rs = R1 + R2 + …
Parallel: 1/Rp = 1/R1 + 1/R2 + …

cards.q: Give three equations for electrical power.
cards.a:
P = VI = I²R = V²/R
Power lost inside the battery: P = I²r.
cards.qAf: Gee drie vergelykings vir elektriese drywing.
cards.aAf:
P = VI = I²R = V²/R
Drywing verloor binne-in die battery: P = I²r.

cards.q: You plot terminal potential difference (y) against current (x). How do you find ε and r?
cards.a: The y-intercept is the emf (ε). The gradient is −r, so the internal resistance is the size of the gradient.
cards.qAf: Jy stip terminale potensiaalverskil (y) teen stroom (x). Hoe bepaal jy ε en r?
cards.aAf: Die y-afsnit is die EMK (ε). Die gradiënt is −r, dus is die interne weerstand die grootte van die gradiënt.

cards.q: State Kirchhoff's current law and what it is based on.
cards.a: The total current entering a junction equals the total current leaving it. It follows from conservation of charge.
cards.qAf: Stel Kirchhoff se stroomwet en waarop dit gebaseer is.
cards.aAf: Die totale stroom wat 'n aansluiting binnegaan, is gelyk aan die totale stroom wat dit verlaat. Dit volg uit die behoud van lading.

cards.q: How do you calculate the electrical energy used by a device?
cards.a: W = VIΔt = PΔt (also I²RΔt or V²Δt/R). Energy in joules, time in seconds.
cards.qAf: Hoe bereken jy die elektriese energie wat 'n toestel gebruik?
cards.aAf: W = VIΔt = PΔt (ook I²RΔt of V²Δt/R). Energie in joule, tyd in sekondes.

cards.q: What energy conversion takes place in a generator, and in a motor?
cards.a:
Generator: mechanical (kinetic) energy → electrical energy.
Motor: electrical energy → mechanical (kinetic) energy.
cards.qAf: Watter energie-omskakeling vind in 'n generator plaas, en in 'n motor?
cards.aAf:
Generator: meganiese (kinetiese) energie → elektriese energie.
Motor: elektriese energie → meganiese (kinetiese) energie.

cards.q: State Faraday's law of electromagnetic induction.
cards.a: The emf induced in a conductor is directly proportional to the rate of change of magnetic flux (flux linkage) through the conductor.
cards.qAf: Stel Faraday se wet van elektromagnetiese induksie.
cards.aAf: Die EMK wat in 'n geleier geïnduseer word, is direk eweredig aan die tempo van verandering van magnetiese vloed (vloedkoppeling) deur die geleier.

cards.q: What is the structural difference between an AC and a DC generator?
cards.a: An AC generator uses slip rings. A DC generator uses a split-ring commutator, which reverses the connections every half turn so the current in the external circuit always flows in one direction.
cards.qAf: Wat is die strukturele verskil tussen 'n WS- en 'n GS-generator?
cards.aAf: 'n WS-generator gebruik sleepringe. 'n GS-generator gebruik 'n splitring-kommutator, wat die verbindings elke halwe draai omkeer sodat die stroom in die eksterne stroombaan altyd in een rigting vloei.

cards.q: What does the commutator do in a DC motor?
cards.a: It reverses the direction of the current in the coil every half turn, so the coil keeps rotating in the same direction.
cards.qAf: Wat doen die kommutator in 'n GS-motor?
cards.aAf: Dit keer die rigting van die stroom in die spoel elke halwe draai om, sodat die spoel aanhou om in dieselfde rigting te draai.

cards.q: In which position of the coil is the induced emf a maximum, and when is it zero?
cards.a: Maximum when the plane of the coil is parallel to the magnetic field (flux changes fastest). Zero when the plane is perpendicular to the field.
cards.qAf: In watter posisie van die spoel is die geïnduseerde EMK 'n maksimum, en wanneer is dit nul?
cards.aAf: Maksimum wanneer die vlak van die spoel parallel aan die magnetiese veld is (vloed verander die vinnigste). Nul wanneer die vlak loodreg op die veld is.

cards.q: Define the rms value of an AC potential difference.
cards.a: The AC potential difference that dissipates the same amount of energy (power) as an equivalent DC potential difference.
cards.qAf: Definieer die RMS-waarde van 'n WS-potensiaalverskil.
cards.aAf: Die WS-potensiaalverskil wat dieselfde hoeveelheid energie (drywing) verbruik as 'n ekwivalente GS-potensiaalverskil.

cards.q: How are rms and maximum (peak) values related?
cards.a:
Vrms = Vmax / √2 and Irms = Imax / √2.
Average power: Pave = Vrms·Irms = ½Vmax·Imax.
cards.qAf: Hoe hou RMS- en maksimum (piek-) waardes verband?
cards.aAf:
Vrms = Vmaks / √2 en Irms = Imaks / √2.
Gemiddelde drywing: Pgem = Vrms·Irms = ½Vmaks·Imaks.

cards.q: South African mains supply is 230 V rms. What is the peak voltage?
cards.qAf: Suid-Afrikaanse hooftoevoer is 230 V RMS. Wat is die piekspanning?

cards.q: Why is electricity transmitted over long distances at high voltage?
cards.a: For the same power, high voltage means low current, so less energy is lost as heat in the cables (Ploss = I²R). Transformers, which only work with AC, step the voltage up and back down.
cards.qAf: Waarom word elektrisiteit oor lang afstande teen hoë spanning oorgedra?
cards.aAf: Vir dieselfde drywing beteken hoë spanning 'n lae stroom, dus gaan minder energie as hitte in die kabels verlore (Pverlies = I²R). Transformators, wat net met WS werk, transformeer die spanning op en weer af.

cards.q: Why does a motor draw a large current when it starts?
cards.a: A spinning motor acts as a generator and produces a back emf that opposes the supply. At start-up there is no back emf yet, so the current is large.
cards.qAf: Waarom trek 'n motor 'n groot stroom wanneer dit begin?
cards.aAf: 'n Draaiende motor werk soos 'n generator en wek 'n teen-EMK op wat die toevoer teenwerk. By die begin is daar nog geen teen-EMK nie, dus is die stroom groot.

cards.q: Give one advantage of AC over DC.
cards.a: AC voltage can be stepped up or down with transformers, so it can be transmitted efficiently over long distances.
cards.qAf: Gee een voordeel van WS bo GS.
cards.aAf: WS-spanning kan met transformators op- of afgetransformeer word, dus kan dit doeltreffend oor lang afstande oorgedra word.

cards.q: What is the photoelectric effect?
cards.a: The process whereby electrons are ejected from a metal surface when light of a suitable frequency shines on it.
cards.qAf: Wat is die fotoelektriese effek?
cards.aAf: Die proses waardeur elektrone uit 'n metaaloppervlak vrygestel word wanneer lig van 'n geskikte frekwensie daarop skyn.

cards.q: Define the work function (W₀).
cards.a: The minimum energy needed to eject an electron from the surface of a metal. Each metal has its own work function.
cards.qAf: Definieer die werkfunksie (W₀).
cards.aAf: Die minimum energie wat nodig is om 'n elektron uit die oppervlak van 'n metaal vry te stel. Elke metaal het sy eie werkfunksie.

cards.q: Define the threshold frequency (f₀).
cards.a: The minimum frequency of light needed to eject electrons from a metal surface. W₀ = hf₀.
cards.qAf: Definieer die drempelfrekwensie (f₀).
cards.aAf: Die minimum frekwensie van lig wat nodig is om elektrone uit 'n metaaloppervlak vry te stel. W₀ = hf₀.

cards.q: Write down the photoelectric equation.
cards.a:
E = W₀ + Ek(max)
hf = hf₀ + ½mv²max
cards.qAf: Skryf die fotoelektriese vergelyking neer.
cards.aAf:
E = W₀ + Ek(maks)
hf = hf₀ + ½mv²maks

cards.q: How do you calculate the energy of a photon?
cards.a: E = hf = hc/λ, with h = 6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ J·s and c = 3.0 × 10⁸ m·s⁻¹.
cards.qAf: Hoe bereken jy die energie van 'n foton?
cards.aAf: E = hf = hc/λ, met h = 6,63 × 10⁻³⁴ J·s en c = 3,0 × 10⁸ m·s⁻¹.

cards.q: Light above the threshold frequency gets brighter (more intense). What changes?
cards.a: More photons per second, so more electrons are ejected per second (a bigger photocurrent). The maximum kinetic energy of each electron stays the same.
cards.qAf: Lig bo die drempelfrekwensie word helderder (meer intens). Wat verander?
cards.aAf: Meer fotone per sekonde, dus word meer elektrone per sekonde vrygestel ('n groter fotostroom). Die maksimum kinetiese energie van elke elektron bly dieselfde.

cards.q: The frequency of the light is increased. What happens to the ejected electrons?
cards.a: Each photon has more energy, so the maximum kinetic energy of the ejected electrons increases.
cards.qAf: Die frekwensie van die lig word verhoog. Wat gebeur met die vrygestelde elektrone?
cards.aAf: Elke foton het meer energie, dus neem die maksimum kinetiese energie van die vrygestelde elektrone toe.

cards.q: What happens if the light's frequency is below the threshold frequency?
cards.a: No electrons are ejected, no matter how intense the light is.
cards.qAf: Wat gebeur as die lig se frekwensie onder die drempelfrekwensie is?
cards.aAf: Geen elektrone word vrygestel nie, maak nie saak hoe intens die lig is nie.

cards.q: What does the photoelectric effect show about the nature of light?
cards.a: Light has a particle nature: it is made of photons (packets of energy). The wave model cannot explain the effect.
cards.qAf: Wat wys die fotoelektriese effek oor die aard van lig?
cards.aAf: Lig het 'n deeltjie-aard: dit bestaan uit fotone (pakkies energie). Die golfmodel kan die effek nie verklaar nie.

cards.q: How is an emission spectrum formed, and what does it look like?
cards.a: Excited atoms emit photons of specific frequencies as electrons drop to lower energy levels. It looks like bright coloured lines on a dark background.
cards.qAf: Hoe word 'n emissiespektrum gevorm, en hoe lyk dit?
cards.aAf: Opgewekte atome stel fotone van spesifieke frekwensies vry soos elektrone na laer energievlakke val. Dit lyk soos helder gekleurde lyne op 'n donker agtergrond.

cards.q: How is an absorption spectrum formed, and what does it look like?
cards.a: White light passes through a cool gas, whose atoms absorb specific frequencies. It looks like a continuous spectrum with dark lines, in the same positions as that element's emission lines.
cards.qAf: Hoe word 'n absorpsiespektrum gevorm, en hoe lyk dit?
cards.aAf: Wit lig gaan deur 'n koel gas, waarvan die atome spesifieke frekwensies absorbeer. Dit lyk soos 'n kontinue spektrum met donker lyne, in dieselfde posisies as daardie element se emissielyne.

cards.q: Why does every element have its own unique line spectrum?
cards.a: Each element has its own set of energy levels, so its atoms emit and absorb only certain photon energies (frequencies). The spectrum acts like a fingerprint.
cards.qAf: Waarom het elke element sy eie unieke lynspektrum?
cards.aAf: Elke element het sy eie stel energievlakke, dus stel sy atome net sekere foton-energieë (frekwensies) vry of absorbeer dit. Die spektrum werk soos 'n vingerafdruk.
